svg.text: The ladder: a wing of the temple for each grade
The same verb all the way (keep the balance); new tools each year; the pictures fade into numbers and letters
recipe boxes: what is in one
take and share on both pans;
none or many; two crystal kinds;
The fade (concreteness fading): the same altar, seen more abstractly as the child grows
runes only: the pans in mist
